aesthetic: Kritische Distanz — Swiss International restraint enacted as epistemological skepticism; paper-white ground, asymmetric right-anchored type, and modular six-column tension that refuses visual resolution
chromaticArc: The deck breathes almost entirely on Archival Warm White, with Vellum Cream surfacing on three chapter-break dividers at slides 1, 20, and 40; Concrete Warm Gray appears only in ###-label tracking and thin rule lines; Lecture Black is reserved for title text and two signal moments where the course confronts technological determinism.
gridStrategy: Titles anchor right at col 30–38 with 400-weight type, body text occupies a narrow 30-col measure starting at col 4–6, and the left third of every slide remains deliberately empty — chapter dividers invert this by centering a single word at massive scale, while the six-lens modules use staggered column starts (col 4, 8, 12) that never align, enacting the productive irresolution of competing perspectives.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: No secondary font; all typographic hierarchy achieved through size, tracking, and position within the grid

accentStrategy: No decorative accent elements; hierarchy is communicated exclusively through spatial position, letterspacing (0.12em on labels, 0.02em on body), and the occasional New Wave rotation of a single ### label at 90° to mark conceptual friction points between lenses.
